difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a section of the distributional path fibration on X by transporting a finite-support section of its universal cover through the explicitly defined path-lifting homeomorphism and then mixing the path distributions over Y. Its essential obligation is to use the distributional construction for the composite covering, whose support points need not lie in one fiber of the intermediate universal covering, while ensuring that the projected paths all start at the same x and that support has size at most (n+1)(r+1). This source-local construction establishes the covering multiplicative bound and is the H2 residual; the supplied definitions, naturality and lifting lemmas are uncounted prerequisites, not an assumption of the final inequality.
